title: Afrofuturism
content: Apply Afrofuturist aesthetic blending African diaspora culture with science fiction. Rich colors: royal purple, gold, deep blue, earth tones. African patterns: kente, mud cloth, tribal geometrics. Futuristic technology with African design. Cosmic and spiritual elements. Include natural hair and African features in imagery. Egyptian and Ethiopian influences. Empowering, cosmic, heritage-meets-future atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create Afrofuturist aesthetic blending African heritage with sci-fi technology and cosmic spirituality.

variants.advanced: Apply Afrofuturist aesthetic blending African diaspora heritage with speculative futures. Color palette: rich and regal - royal purple (#7851a9), gold (#ffd700), deep blue (#00008b), burnt orange (#cc5500), earth brown (#8b4513), black, cosmic silver. African patterns: kente cloth geometric weaves, mud cloth (bogolanfini) symbols, Ndebele patterns, Ankara prints - implement as backgrounds or accents (SVG patterns). Technology design: futuristic tech incorporating African aesthetic - curved organic forms, tribal patterns on surfaces, Wakanda-inspired. Cosmic elements: stars, galaxies, celestial bodies, spiritual connection to universe. Ancient-future: Egyptian (hieroglyphs, pyramids, Nefertiti), Ethiopian (Lalibela, Solomonic), Great Zimbabwe references merged with sci-fi. Sacred geometry: African mathematical patterns, fractal village layouts. Typography: bold, powerful fonts, can incorporate African-inspired letterforms. Imagery: celebrate natural Black features, Afros, braids, African dress, strong powerful figures. Nature connection: African landscapes, baobabs, savannas, merged with tech. Music influence: Afrobeat, jazz, electronic - visualize rhythm. Spirituality: ancestral connection, Sankofa (looking back to move forward), cosmic consciousness. Interactive: flowing, rhythmic animations, cosmic particle effects. Fashion: African fashion meets sci-fi suits. Implementation: SVG for patterns, careful color layering. Accessibility: rich colors provide good contrast, ensure diverse representation is authentic and respectful.
